dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script_name.py"]
explanation: 1. requirements.txt includes pinned versions of detected imports (lxml, requests, yaml/PyYAML, aura) for stability. 2. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base, sets /app as workdir, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies all files, and assumes a main script named 'your_script_name.py' (replace with actual entrypoint). Slim image reduces size while maintaining Python 3.9 compatibility.
